architectureDecisions: D1: Add narrow `how-evolution.js`; keep the BB-035 self-upgrade pilot unchanged. Reuse its pinning/independence/budget patterns, not its pilot-specific contract.
D2: `HOW_EVOLUTION_FINDING` pins Integration-I subject/evidence, domain/workload, baseline policy/strategy and one bounded HOW axis. It is evidence only.

D3: `HOW_EVOLUTION_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL/v1` pins fixed WHAT/acceptance, finding, baseline/candidate refs+digests, producer, evaluator/policy, case-set digest, metric thresholds, replay/budget, evidence snapshot and expected policy-head tuple.
D4: Cases are trigger + regression + evaluator-owned holdout. Producer cannot rewrite holdout after protocol creation; baseline/candidate use identical membership.

D5: Compare paired per-case runs. Hard gates: no new critical failure, policy/evidence completeness, recovery non-regression. Heldout primary metric must meet predeclared minEffect; aggregate gain cannot hide a critical regression.
D6: Add `how-evolution-jev-adapter.js`: exact model/policy/request/response/evidence identity, typed outcomes, bounded evidence and fail-closed transport/model handling; no mutation methods.
D7: Reuse trust-boundary + verification-assessment; add HOW-specific freshness over semantic subject, evaluator policy, cases, evidence and expected policy head.

D8: SATISFIED evaluation creates only a promotion proposal. A distinct promoter revalidates pins/current head, then calls existing `createDomainExecutionPolicyPublisher`; its authority check, generation+1 and CAS remain the only policy-currentness mutation.
D9: Promotion affects new attempts only; ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempts reuse their immutable binding.
D10: Rollback uses the same independent fenced publisher path to create a successor generation selecting an exact prior accepted strategy and linking the reversed promotion/evaluation.

D11: Findings, protocol, paired runs, Jev receipt, evaluation, proposal and decisions are immutable ref+digest artifacts; mutable heads store only compact current pointers for fresh-process reconstruction.
implementationSlices: J1 — Finding: bind one BB-058 causal projection into immutable evidence-only HOW_EVOLUTION_FINDING.
J2 — Protocol: pin fixed WHAT, A/B HOW refs, actors, trigger/regression/holdout cases, metrics, replay/budget, evidence and expected policy head.
J3 — Evaluation: paired same-case runs + hard gates; Jev handles semantic rubric only and persists exact receipt.
J4 — Promotion: proposal-only evaluation, three-role separation, freshness recheck, existing policy publisher generation+1/CAS.
J5 — Pinning/rollback: old attempt keeps old binding; new attempt sees promoted head; rollback is another fenced successor generation.
J6 — Reconstruction: fresh process resolves full ref chain; reject WHAT drift, critical regression, holdout/evaluator/evidence/head drift, unauthorized actors and history rewrite.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: Jev integration has an explicit adapter/contract: its input, output, policy identity, evidence refs, freshness rules and trust verification are durable and independently checkable.
A candidate producer cannot evaluate or promote its own candidate, and a Jev PASS alone cannot mutate ExecutionPolicy, ProductHistory, QualityAcceptance or ProductOutcome currentness.
PASS may produce an independently reviewable promotion proposal; FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, stale evidence or authority mismatch deterministically keeps the baseline.

An accepted promotion creates a new immutable ExecutionPolicy/ExecutionStrategy version for the exact domain/workload scope, while an already-bound in-flight/recovery attempt continues using its old binding.
Promotion racing with changed semantics, acceptance/evaluator policy or evidence currentness fails closed and requires a fresh evaluation.
Rollback creates a new auditable policy generation pointing to the exact accepted baseline and preserves the candidate/evaluation/promotion history.

examples.adoptedConclusion: Pin case-set/evaluator versions, compare per case, preserve an independently approved baseline and reject incomplete/missing cases.

nonGoals: Do not import an experiment platform, generic optimizer, model registry or Kubernetes rollout controller into ExHarness.
Do not use star count as correctness evidence; repository maturity only qualifies examples for pattern inspection.
Do not claim statistical generalization from the bounded BB-059 proof; later held-out real-delivery validation remains separate roadmap work.

fixedSubject: scenarioSet ref/version/digest with trigger, regression and evaluator-owned holdout partitions
metricPolicy ref/digest with minEffect and max cost/token/latency regression constraints
replay policy: provider/model/config refs, stochastic repeatCount and seed policy where supported
evaluationProtocolContract.variationRule: Only declared HOW surfaces may differ. Any WHAT/WorkContract/acceptance change invalidates the comparison.
evaluationProtocolContract.runRule: Baseline and candidate execute identical pinned cases. Deterministic workloads may run once; stochastic model-backed workloads require at least three paired repeats unless the pinned metric policy explicitly declares a stronger sample plan.
evaluationProtocolContract.holdoutRule: Candidate producer cannot mutate evaluator-owned recorded holdout membership after protocol creation.
evaluationProtocolContract.incompleteRule: Missing case, required measurement, evaluator receipt or evidence ref => INCONCLUSIVE; never coerce to zero/pass.

hardGates: no new failure on any pinned critical product/acceptance regression case
policy/authority compliance = 100% and no forbidden external mutation
recovery success must not regress on pinned recovery cases
metricPolicyContract.valueGate: heldout primary metric delta candidate-baseline must meet protocol.minEffect; minEffect is fixed before candidate evaluation
operationalMetrics: task/acceptance success per case and aggregate
input/output/total tokens and provider/model calls when observable
cost in provider billing units when observable
median/p95 latency and runtime invocation duration when observable
metricPolicyContract.comparisonRule: Store paired case-level deltas first. Aggregate averages are secondary and cannot override a critical-case regression.
metricPolicyContract.uncertaintyRule: Provider/evaluator failure or unavailable required usage/latency data makes the affected gate INCONCLUSIVE; bounded evidence does not establish statistical generalization.

jevAdapterContract.port: Evaluator.evaluate(protocol, evidence) -> immutable semantic evaluation receipt
pinned: canonical request hash and typed question ids
jevAdapterContract.trust: evaluateTrustBoundary verifies evaluator and evidence-producer authority; verification-assessment combines semantic and deterministic evidence.
jevAdapterContract.failure: transport error, malformed response, unexpected model/policy, missing atomic outcome or authority failure => INCONCLUSIVE/KEEP_BASELINE
jevAdapterContract.secretBoundary: TYPESAFE_API_KEY is supplied by process/CI environment only; never persist or return the key.
jevAdapterContract.authority: Adapter has no repository, product, policy-publisher, promotion or rollback capability.

authorityContract.findingAuthority: HOW_EVOLUTION_FINDING is read-only evidence and grants no candidate/evaluation/promotion authority.
authorityContract.evaluationAuthority: Evaluation can return PROPOSE_FOR_PROMOTION or KEEP_BASELINE only.
authorityContract.productAuthority: No HOW-evolution artifact changes ProductHistory, QualityAcceptance, ProductOutcome or accepted WHAT.

promotionContract.proposal: HOW_EVOLUTION_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL pins protocol/evaluation refs+digests, proposed strategy/policy, expected current policy head and required authority.
preconditions: all protocol/evaluation/evidence/evaluator artifacts resolve exact digests
current ExecutionPolicyHead exactly equals protocol evaluated baseline subjectKey/revision/generation/policyRef
semantic subject, evaluator policy, scenario set and evidence snapshot are still current
promotionContract.mutation: Store immutable candidate ExecutionStrategyDescriptor, then call existing createDomainExecutionPolicyPublisher with generation=current+1. Existing publisher verifies authority and CAS-fences the head.
promotionContract.race: If head or any currentness subject changes before publication, fail closed and require fresh evaluation; never silently rebase proposal.
promotionContract.attempts: New attempts may resolve the promoted head; ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempts retain their immutable ExecutionAttemptBinding.

rollbackContract.trigger: Independent authority selects an exact previously accepted strategy/policy lineage and supplies rollback reason evidence.
rollbackContract.mutation: Publish another immutable ExecutionPolicy generation through the same currentness+authority+CAS path with reasonKind=ROLLBACK and exact targetStrategyRef.
rollbackContract.history: No artifact/head history rewrite; the rollback successor remains auditable beside the reverted promotion.

immutableArtifacts: baseline/candidate EVALUATION_RUN receipts with per-case measurements
mutableHeads: ExecutionPolicyHead only; experiment/evaluation artifacts have immutable refs+digests
durabilityContract.storage: Use an injected artifact-store port with content-addressed immutable refs; local JSON adapter is test/dev only. Large evidence/run bodies stay outside mutable head stores.
durabilityContract.reconstruction: A fresh process starts from current policy head or a promotion/rollback receipt and resolves the entire provenance chain by exact refs+digests.
durabilityContract.replay: Re-evaluation requires the original protocol/scenario/evaluator/evidence identities; any drift creates a new protocol/evaluation rather than mutating old evidence.

deliveryContract.precondition: BB-058 DONE before WORKER execution; its causal observation is evidence only.
deliveryContract.completion: Criterion-specific tests + agentic regression + repository verify; independent Jev judgment remains required.
deliveryContract.forbidden: No WHAT mutation, generic optimizer, self-acceptance, pilot rewrite or direct policy-head mutation.

ciContract.liveJev: Real semantic Jev evidence requires TYPESAFE_API_KEY outside repo; transport/model failure is INCONCLUSIVE.

migrationContract.rollback: Revert additive HOW-evolution module/export/docs only; do not rewrite existing execution history.
